annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes common civil aviation safety rules and the EU Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), with certification and oversight tasks.
Covers unmanned aircraft regardless of mass, with rules proportionate to operational risk.
Requires digital, interoperable registration of drones and drone operators, compliant with GDPR.
Sets essential requirements for airworthiness, environmental protection and information security, with a performance-based, risk-proportionate approach.
Excludes military, police and customs aircraft, but lets Member States opt in.
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation 2018/1139 sets common civil aviation safety rules and establishes EASA. It brings unmanned aircraft of any mass into scope, with risk-proportionate rules, drone and operator registration, and certification. It also covers airworthiness, environmental protection and cybersecurity, and delegates detailed rules to implementing and delegated acts.
annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 of the European Parliament and of the Council on common rules in the field of civil aviation and establishing a European Union Aviation Safety Agency
